system.description: A Focus for a capable explorer who discovers, survives, and thrives in the wild.

abilities.name: Exploration Survivor
abilities.description: After studying a new region and succeeding at survival, find useful supplies, feed allies, and remember notable locations.

abilities.name: Tough
abilities.description: You can take one additional minor wound.

abilities.name: Untamed Recovery
abilities.description: Gain one additional one-action recovery each day.

abilities.name: Beast Companion
abilities.description: Gain a level 2 beast follower that accompanies you and follows your instructions.

abilities.name: Experienced Explorer
abilities.description: Gain protection from poison, disease, harsh wilderness conditions, and find food and water in the wild.

abilities.name: Animal Senses and Sensibilities
abilities.description: Receive warning before most nearby level 4 or lower ambushes and traps, without granting attackers an advantage from surprise.

abilities.name: Wilderness Encouragement
abilities.description: In the wilderness, help an ally take an extra recovery or remove a moderate wound.

abilities.name: Wild Camouflage
abilities.description: Use clothing, disguise, and terrain knowledge to gain two assets to Speed and stealth tasks in the wild.

abilities.name: Wilderness Awareness
abilities.description: Extend your senses across the wilderness and ask the GM one simple general question about the area.

abilities.name: Explorer's Awareness
abilities.description: Gain two free levels of Effort when applying Effort to initiative or perception tasks.

abilities.name: The Wild Is on Your Side
abilities.description: Nature interferes with nearby foes, hindering all their tasks until your next ten-minute recovery.

abilities.name: One With the Wild
abilities.description: Share a protective bond with the wilderness: allies gain Edge, recover twice as many points, and natural life will not knowingly harm them.

abilities.name: Survivor
abilities.description: Rally from a minor or moderate wound without spending Might; the ability renews after recovery.
